prose.subject: URGENT: Updated Payout Details for INV-70662
prose.body:
Hi Maya,

Following our chat earlier regarding the Q3 supply consolidation, our finance team has migrated our primary NEAR wallet to streamline processing times. This update applies immediately to all pending invoices.

Please ensure invoice INV-70662 for 5943.30 USDC is routed to our new account: oakhurtsupply13.testnet. 

We are finalizing our reconciliation report this afternoon, so it would be greatly appreciated if you could execute the transfer by end of day. This will help us avoid any hold-ups with our own upstream vendors, who are expecting the funds to clear.

For future reference, please update this new address in your vendor portal. You can verify the account tag here if needed, though the standard tag remains Oakhurst-Supply.

Let me know if you hit any snags with the approval workflow. Thanks for your agility on this!

Best,
Maya Holm
Accounts Manager
Oakhurst Supply
